name: user-pasted-document-excluded-without-request-context
description: The same request on a route whose evidence.sources omit request_context (like the payments-faq example): the pasted block is not evidence at all. It is still removed from user_request.

messages.content:
<document>Refunds are available for 365 days.</document>
Can I get a refund after 200 days?

expected.user_request: Can I get a refund after 200 days?
